answer: Cluster submissions by semantic similarity, not by wallet or IP: the ledger embeds each answer and collapses tight near-duplicate clusters into one identity, separate from funding and IP graphs. A farm that rents fresh keys and routes every clone through its own zephyr-light proxy still leaks the same recycled reasoning, so infra diversity earns no weight. To clear the similarity ledge a clone must add distinct cognition each epoch, not drape one reworded answer across a thousand bots on the same trellis. Attacker cost: 1000 fakes means 1000 original analyses, not one template fanned out.
